notes.title: New Guntouchables update (v. 1.0.4) is adding text chat
notes.notes: [h1]Hello Preppers![/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve heard you loud and clear! - you wanted better ways to communicate with your squad in-game. With the [b]1.0.4 update[/b], we’re excited to introduce [b]text chat[/b]! Just hit '[b]Enter'[/b] and type away to coordinate strategies, request healing or ammo, or simply connect with your teammates.[/p][p][/p][p]This update is a little bigger than the previous updates, and we are really excited to share it with you. If you've been following some of the recent Steam posts, you already know that we have been working hard to address the most critical feedback and your most highly requested features. [/p][p]As always, thank you so much for your feedback - it helps us make the game better![/p][p][/p][h3]What's new in 1.0.4:[/h3][h3][/h3][p][b][u]⌨️In-game text chat[/u][/b][/p][p]You have requested better ways to communicate and connect with the other players in the game. Guntouchables 1.0.4 will introduce a brand-new text chat feature, allowing players to request healing or ammo, sync strategies or whatever else they find a need to communicate.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]🥾Tools for inactive players[/u][/b][/p][p]The new update add functionality allowing the host to kick other players from the game to prevent someone who is inactive from blocking further progress.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]🎒Consumable drop option[/u][/b][/p][p]Pressing "R" when holding a consumable, will now put it back on the ground. This will make it easier to optimize the distribution of consumables between the players.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]🎮Steam Deck improvements[/u][/b][/p][p]We have made some visual tweaks to make the game look better on the smaller screen on the Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]💾Player progression backup[/u][/b][/p][p]Unfortunately, some players have been unlucky and lost progression. As much as we would like to, we cannot help restore this progression. However, we are looking to add a solution that would help players restore their progression if this should happen again in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]🔧Bug fixing and performance optimizations[/u][/b][/p][p]We are making ongoing efforts to improve the game's performance. We know that some players have reported issues related to unstable online connection. We are making continuous efforts to identify and solve these issues.[/p][p][/p][p]We really hope you will enjoy these additions and continue to support the game![/p][p][/p][p]XOXO,[/p][p][/p][p]Game Swing[/p]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Wrap-up + Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Preppers![/h1]

It's been 2 weeks since we stopped the Closed Alpha playtest to focus on the next big milestone in Guntouchables' development - [b]Steam Next Fest![/b]

We didn't know what to expect from the Alpha playtest, so we were absolutely blown away by the results and the reception. An overwhelming 20.000 players signed up to participate in the Alpha playtest during the 13 days it was live, and the feedback we received was nothing short of invaluable. Bugs were reported, opinions were shared, and balancing was discussed... and we are learning so much! ːsteamhappyː

[b]A huge THANK YOU goes out to each and everyone who participated![/b]

As you may suspect, two weeks is not nearly enough time to process all the feedback we received during the Alpha test. However, we have worked our butts off to include as many cool changes and features as possible. Especially for those players requesting an extra challenge! ːDevil2ː

[h3]Here is a list of what you can expect: [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/a35a9574e6cf11cb08229407d7778714c8f628b4.png[/img]
[h3]Gameplay:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unlocked the 'Apocalypse' excursion
[*] Added new boss to the 'Apocalypse' excursion
[*] Added 'Natural Selection' Challenges for all excursions
[*] Added Grenade launcher to the game, renamed old Grenade launcher to Rocket launcher
[*] Added 'Explosion Radius Mod' for Launchers
[*] Changed the Fire and Ice bullets to have an AoE
[*] Fixed the Voucher perk
[*] Decreased the reload time for the Assault Rifle
[*] Increased Player's movement acceleration (To fix sluggishness while playing with controller)
[*] Changed player 'Crates collected' to XP .
[*] Changed weapon XP to 'mods installed'
[*] Changed difficulty scaling between missions
[*] Increased enemy health between missions significantly
[*] Later Excursions have a faster threat timer
[*] Added a new ingame shop, where you can unlock game content from
[/list]
[h3]Visuals:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the visuals for selecting excursion
[*] Changed visuals for the destructible crates
[*] Changed the visuals for bean cans
[*] Changed the visuals on game-over and game-won showing amount of crates and beans the player collected
[/list]
[h3]Sound:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added sounds to various buttons
[*] Added ambient sounds to Baxter's Bazaar
[*] Added crate destruction and can pickup sounds
[/list]
[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new Steam Achievements (29 in total)
[*] Added gameplay pause in Single Player
[*] Added Network settings in Options allowing players to manually choose their region
[*] Updated Controller button mapping
[*] Various other smaller bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Alpha - Update Live
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello preppers,[/h2]

We have a small update to the playtest build going live as you are read this.

We’re only 2 days into the Alpha playtest, and we are blown away by your interest and dedication so far!!! 

Thanks to your reports, we’ve already been able to fix multiple critical issues - huge thanks for that! ♥️ 

It’s also clear that a lot of you are looking for an even bigger challenge… This is something we cannot address right away, but it looks like we’ll need to step things up! 🔫 🩸 


[h3]Here is a list of the changes featured in this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Controller support and icons
[*] Added Boss Defeated title
[*] Added some missing localization strings
[*] Added colliders to walls in the cabins
[*] Added sounds for Breeder Boss
[*] Added voicelines when voting on enemy mutations
[*] Updated the Breeder boss icon
[*] Updated american-pistol name
[*] Updated intro / outro for some bosses
[*] Updated boundaries for voicelines so they dont overlap as much
[*] Updated Ryan Gossip voicelines
[*] Fixed bug where you could beat the Wartusk boss by dying in single player
[*] Fixes a bug where you could soft lock in the upgrade screen by doubleclicking the weapon
[*] Fixed sound bug for minigun
[*] Fixed game names being empty on Replay
[/list]


Please know that your support makes an ENORMOUS difference, and we are truly grateful for it.
Whether you’re sharing feedback about your experience, expressing ideas for future development, or reporting bugs and crashes, your input is invaluable!

We’re a small development team, and your feedback helps us focus our efforts where it matters most.

Stay prepared,
-Game Swing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/a35a9574e6cf11cb08229407d7778714c8f628b4.png[/img]

notes.title: First changelog since the January open playtest
notes.notes:
[b]Summary[/b]
Each mission now has side missions, so beside the main goal of retrieving the UpCrates™ the players have different side-objectives that will pay out cash to spend in the armory.

Players can now pick from the whole weapon arsenal if the have the cash to pay for it.

We've added a lot of new maps and enemies.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] New environments: Facility
[*] New side-mission types: Repair the antennas, Destroy the nests, Exterminate the enemy breeders, Free the civilians
[*] New enemies: New base enemy, and elemental mutations for most enemy types (Fire spitter, Ice runner, Bile bugs etc)
[*] Destructible walls
[*] Final boss: New map layout and tweaked 
[/list]
[b]UI/Meta[/b]
We've worked a lot with explaining the systems to the players in an easy to digest way.
[list]
[*] Player cash
[*] Shop
[*] New progression overview
[*] New mission complete screen showing enemies upgrading from crates left behind
[/list]
[b]Say hi, join our community and be part of making the game better![/b]
We are still doing playtests every friday, it's always a hoot since we are pushing new stuff that not everyone on the team has seen in action before these tests. It's a great time to join and add your impressions and feedback straight to the developers. We don't always post them here, but they still happen over at [url=game-swing.com/discord]OUR DISCORD[/url]
